audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Urgot wins Level 1, but the prose (early, spikes[0], whys[0]) all say Level 1 is Darius', and the packet levelChart also has Darius at Level 1.
audit.why: Urgot has neither Purge nor Disdain at level 1; Darius' base stats plus Hemorrhage win a standing level-1 fight.
audit.corrected: Level 1 = Darius (6.5/10); levels 2 onward stay Urgot. HARD 8/10 overall retained.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and cooldown text carry no real numbers, so 'trade when his W is down' reads as always available.
audit.why: Purge is 12/9/6/3/0s — at rank 5 there is effectively no down-window. Disdain (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) is the punishable cooldown, not Purge.
audit.corrected: All-in keyed to Disdain's 14-16s window; Purge's rank-5 zero cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text credits Purge with the shield ('his W Purge shreds you while he shields'), and never states that Fear Beyond Death impales the first CHAMPION hit.
audit.why: Riot's text: Disdain shields Urgot and hurls the caught champion aside; Purge only slows Urgot himself while firing Echoing Flames. R impales the first enemy champion, so minions do not body-block it.
audit.corrected: Shield attributed to Disdain; R's no-minion-block behaviour stated; Purge's self-slow used as the pin condition for Crippling Strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere in the cooldown section.
audit.corrected: Disdain 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, Purge 12/9/6/3/0, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70, Apprehend 26s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get hit by his E' but its body describes Darius burning his own E.
audit.why: Title and body describe different abilities.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to describe Disdain shielding him and hurling Darius out of stick range.

edits.after: Purge is a 12s cooldown at rank 1 but 0s by rank 5, so 'trade when his W is down' only holds early. Purge self-slows him — land Crippling Strike over it and he cannot walk out of your Q ring or the bleed.
edits.before: Urgot out-trades with his W shotgun knees, so trade only when his W is down. Dodge his E flip (it sets up his combo), and stack bleed for the R race. Don't chase past the wave into Disdain (Flip).

edits.after: - Urgot Disdain (E): 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — his only engage and his only escape, and the shield rides on it. Bait it, then pull. Urgot Purge (W): 12/9/6/3/0s — the 'wait it out' plan dies at rank 5. Urgot Fear Beyond Death (R): 100/85/70s, and it impales the first champion hit, so minions never body-block it. Darius Apprehend (E): 26s at rank 1 — spend it on his Disdain recovery, never predictably.
edits.before: - Urgot Disdain (Flip): matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it, then pull. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.

edits.after: Purge is 12s at rank 1; step up the moment it ends, W-slow him through the recovery, land the Q outer ring, and leave at 3-4 stacks.
edits.before: Pull Urgot as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.

edits.after: Disdain shields him and hurls you away — losing the stick, not the damage, is what kills your all-in.
edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

edits.after: Track Disdain (E), 14-16s: it is his engage, his shield and his escape. Pull only while it is down.
edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Bait it, then pull. Engage only while it is down.

edits.after: Only level 1 is yours — take it with an outer-Q trade before Purge exists. From 2 his W machine-guns leg blasts into you at close range and punishes every step you take to E-pull, and Disdain — not Purge — is what shields him and hurls you away.
edits.before: Only level 1 is yours — grab it with an outer-Q trade. From level 2 his W Purge shreds you while he shields, and his passive shotgun-leg autos punish every step you take to E-pull. His W kites your entire Hemorrhage-stacking plan.

edits.after: Level 1 is your only clean window — force an outer-Q trade before Purge comes online. From 2, Purge pours his leg blasts into you at close range, and Disdain (16s at rank 1) shields him and throws you out of his way, so a blind E-pull commit hands him the trade.
edits.before: Level 1 is your only clean window — force an outer-Q trade before his W Purge is up. Once he can pop Purge from level 2 he gains a shield and rapid-fire leg autos that out-trade your Hemorrhage stacks, and his range makes your E-pull commitment risky.

edits.after: From 2 onward Urgot owns the lane. Purge kites your all-in and his legs punish every approach. At 6 his R impales the first champion it hits — minions never body-block it — and below the threshold it drags you in and executes, so never dive low while that 100s ult is up.
edits.before: From 2 onward Urgot owns the lane. His W kites your all-in, his passive punishes every approach, and at 6 his R Fear Beyond Death is a below-threshold execute that flips your own low-HP dives into a death — it's a hard lockout your lifesteal can't answer.

notes: Purge (W) does not shield — Disdain (E) does; the old text credited the shield to W. Urgot's Q Corrosive Charge carries a 'dash' flag in the kit file that contradicts Riot's own description (a charge fired at a target location, no dash) — treated as a tooltip-parse misfire and not used. Darius' Apprehend passive percent-armour-pen is unmentioned in this matchup and is relevant vs a tanky Urgot build, but no in-band slot was free without cutting a live fact.
